identification: Art Deco chrome and black glass (Vitrolite style) desk set of the Ranleigh type: two chrome inkwell domes with perpetual calendar (shows AUGUST) on a black glass base, one small chrome pen rest loose; base is dirty and spotted. With two Westclox alarm clocks, a Big Ben (chrome case, black dial, 'Scotland' on dial) and a Baby Ben (brass bezel). Ranleigh maker attribution is from the design match on Google, no maker mark was readable in the photos.

viewing_check: Estimate 30-40, current bid $15. Ranleigh-type desk sets have sold for about $20-97 on eBay AU in the last 3 years (typical $40-85 in good condition; recent prices are steady). This one has a dirty, spotted base and a loose pen rest, so check for chips on the glass and missing ink liners (the red liner is visible in one well, the other looks empty). Clocks add only about $15-20 each. Glass base is heavy and fragile to post.
